#include <vector>

    n %= use;
    
    if (n == 0) return times;

long long generate_ones(int digits) {
    long long result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < digits; ++i) {
        result = result * 10 + 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int solve(long long n, int max_digits) {
    if (max_digits == 0) return 0;
    
    long long repunit = generate_ones(max_digits);
    int count = (n / repunit) * max_digits;
    n %= repunit;
    
    if (n == 0) return count;
    
    int option1 = max_digits + solve(repunit - n, max_digits - 1);
    int option2 = solve(n, max_digits - 1);
    
    return count + min(option1, option2);
}

int main() {
    cout << solve(0, 0);
    return 0;
}
